roles.title: AI Automation Software Engineer Intern
roles.description: Built web dashboards and UI that use LLMs to turn meeting transcripts into action items for the team. Designed, developed, and deployed a Python backend service (Slack bot) that automates calendar, email, and file tasks. Turned free form user requests into JSON commands via LLM APIs, each routed to a Playwright automation, and raised reliability by validating every LLM generated command against a schema before it could touch live systems. Migrated legacy data to PostgreSQL (Supabase), redesigning schemas to speed up queries across 5+ systems.

roles.description: Help students debug Python one on one, grade assignments, and help lead discussion sections. Lead a study and social group for DSC 10 students, reviewing course material and building community.

roles.title: Software Engineer Intern

Engineered candidate filtering and search functionality to streamline applicant review and improve recruiter decision making efficiency. Collaborated with a cross functional development team using Git version control to deliver scalable web application features in a production environment.

roles.title: Full Stack Software Engineer Intern (Part-time)
roles.description: Built the AI chatbot system for Meridian, the lab's npm package that adds AI analytics to any web app. Engineered a prompt to JSON schema layer so the AI renders the best fit front end UI per request. Tested UI generation and data binding end to end in a React, Next.js, and TypeScript app before each release. Worked with product designers and engineers in design meetings to turn user needs into shipped Meridian features.

roles.title: Python Software Developer Intern (Part-time)
roles.description: Built Next.js web apps that made data input and output intuitive for researchers, translating lab requirements into UI. Halved data prep time with a web tool converting raw lab output into ready to analyze GraphPad Prism datasets. Cut neural signal analysis time over 6x (1 hour to under 10 minutes) with automated Python pipelines on gigabytes of data.

roles.title: Programming Instructor & Event Coordinator

Organized and invited four industry professionals for a STEM career seminar with over 200 participants. Taught 300+ students in Python, drone robotics, Lego robotics, and machine learning.
